r1-0.notes: Points at viewer (finger, not the staff); staff upright behind; windsock, railing, city. Good but r1-1 has a richer station.

hard.hands: pass: thumbs-up hand 4 curled fingers + thumb; staff hand clean

r1-1.notes: Strong likeness (wavy gold hair, gold ram horns, lilac eyes, periwinkle coat dress with gold edges, lilac bow, indigo tights/boots, open grin). Big gold star-in-ring staff upright beside her head. Station: striped windsock, slatted instrument box, rain gauges, railing, city, mountains, cumulus. Dutch angle, thumb toward camera.

r1-2.notes: Both hands on the staff, no hand toward camera; background sparser (box, railing, mountains).

r1-3.notes: Very dynamic point and grin; horns oversized; background mostly railing/lamp/trees.

r1-4.notes: Staff planted, open hand toward viewer; instrument box + rain gauge; little camera tilt.

r1-5.notes: Staff swung over shoulder; smaller figure, face less detailed.

r1-6.notes: Thumbs up, dish and box; good, background thinner than r1-1.

checklist.likeness: yes - same hair, ram horns, lilac eyes, coat dress, bow and grin as her portrait
checklist.halo_free: yes (the ring is the staff head)

safety_flags: Eyes at ~35.6% down, just inside the 36% limit; the crop can be nudged down a few px when placed.
